files.justification: Cohesive single-responsibility SQLite-backed store for Project Code Memory (memory ops, code-index ops, daemon-owned semantic embeddings + hybrid lexical/vector search, schema bootstrap, FSEvents watcher, and SQLite primitives over one raw connection). Baselined to satisfy the file-size gate at its current size; a clean decomposition into +Memory/+Code/+Search/+Schema/+SQLite extensions is a tracked follow-on that requires widening ~15 private helpers (execute/queryRows/auditEvent/db/dbQueue/etc.) to internal so cross-file extensions can reach them. The embedding math/codec/RRF already live in a separate file (BurnBarCodeEmbedding.swift).
